bok-choy-medium: A single isolated photorealistic 3D reconstruction reference for a complete loaded produce crate from a Hong Kong street wet market. One low, rectangular, lightly worn timber produce crate, nominally 50 cm wide × 38 cm deep × 15 cm high. Simple thin wooden boards with two slat courses, narrow dark gaps and four small wooden corner blocks. Its flat bottom is fully seated on the studio floor. The fresh produce is naturally packed INSIDE the crate: let the lower pieces disappear into the cavity, leaves or produce touch the inside walls and a few ends crest the rim. Keep the front wall and base clear enough to identify and fit the complete object. Camera at a 35-degree elevation from front-left, natural perspective, see the whole silhouette with margin. Plain seamless light gray backdrop, broad diffuse neutral illumination, minimal contact shadow, natural believable matte textures, rich but realistic colors. No signage, people, text, logos, price cards, scene furniture or extra crates. The result will be used as the single-image input for a textured low-poly 3D reconstruction; keep thin slats readable and the visual separation of produce from wood clear. Pack eight baby Shanghai bok choy heads laid in alternating directions. Broad pale celadon stalks and dark waxy oval leaves, compact individual rosettes and a few curved outer leaves that overlap the rim. Show several pale cut stems near the front and darker overlapping leaves behind.
